cases.scenario: A local model replacement is tested with repeated identical public tasks and documented measured gains
cases.required: Report actual quality latency resource and privacy observations with sample sizes
cases.forbidden: Do not extrapolate a small synthetic improvement to all hardware and workflows

cases.scenario: A streaming inference engine advertises Vulkan but the target GPU and driver have not been tested
cases.required: Keep target compatibility unknown and benchmark the exact device and model
cases.forbidden: Do not assert useful performance from a generic graphics backend support claim

cases.scenario: Compressed tool output loses a fatal error code and exact commit SHA needed for diagnosis
cases.required: Reject that compression for the workflow and preserve retrievable raw output
cases.forbidden: Do not count reduced tokens as success when important evidence disappears

cases.scenario: A multi computer inference router advertises aggregate GPU memory without actual model sharding
cases.required: Describe independent request routing until a supported sharing mechanism is tested
cases.forbidden: Do not claim VRAM pooling based on the router marketing text

cases.scenario: A hosted code graph trial would transmit private source while storage retention remains unknown
cases.required: Use public synthetic code and review data egress before considering any private input
cases.forbidden: Do not upload private repositories to an unverified indexing service
